parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: When we are given the bill
the service charge is often included,
but it depends on the restaurant.
when he goes on a long journey,
as he is afraid he might lose one.
with my plans for the weekend.

parts.text: When we are given the bill in a restaurant, the service charge is often included, but it depends on the restaurant. He always takes two toothbrushes with him when he goes on a long journey, as he is afraid he might lose one. Some people shouted “Congratulations” and everybody raised a glass and said “Cheers”! There's one thing I hate and that is people interfering with my plans for the weekend.
